plain: To make used to something by repeating it.

webster.text: To accustom; to make familiar by frequent use or practice.

more.text: To settle as an inhabitant in a place.

example.quote: It tended also to habituate the instruments of it to shed the blood & riot in the spoils of their fellow Citizens, and consequently trained them up for the service of ambition.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, June 16, 1787
